title: Why songs get stuck in your head 🎵
subject: music
description:
What song is stuck in your head right now? 👇

Why do songs get stuck in your head? Psychologists call them earworms, and a 2015 University of Reading study found a surprisingly simple way to quiet them.

Sources: University of Reading (Beaman et al., Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology, 2015), Durham University Music Science (Jakubowski et al.), Schubert, Music & Science (2023)

scenes.text: You've had a song stuck in your head this week.
Over 90% of people get these earworms at least weekly.
It's rarely the whole song. It's a few seconds, often the chorus, on loop.
Scientists think your short-term memory keeps replaying it, like a phone number you're trying to remember.
But here's the strange part. In a 2015 study, chewing gum cut it by about a third.
